docs.author: Dr. Alan Whitcombe
sentences: Patient is a 50-year-old man with low back pain for about four months.
Denies bowel or bladder changes, fever, weight loss or any history of cancer.
Symptoms persist after more than two months of physical therapy and daily naproxen.
Pain radiates down the right leg to the foot.
Sleeps about six hours a night.
The right Achilles reflex is absent.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
docs.title: Orthopedic clinic visit note

payer_letter: Bluepeak Insurance has reviewed claim A-1018 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of at least six weeks of conservative treatment together with radicular findings or an objective neurological deficit, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document at least six weeks of conservative treatment before imaging. You may request reconsideration within 90 days of this notice.
